name: Shukto
instructions: 1. Fry the bori until golden and set aside; then lightly fry all the vegetables separately and set aside.
2. In the same mustard oil, temper with panch phoron and radhuni.
3. Add ginger paste and sauté briefly, then add the fried vegetables and stir.
4. Add water to cover the vegetables, season with salt and a touch of sugar, and simmer until tender.
5. Stir in the mustard paste mixed with a little water and milk to thicken the gravy.
6. Add the fried bori back in, finish with a dollop of ghee, and remove from heat.
description: Shukto is a sophisticated, traditional Bengali vegetable dish known for its complex flavor profile. It acts as a palate cleanser, traditionally eaten at the start of a multi-course lunch to stimulate the appetite and provide health benefits through its unique combination of bitter vegetables and digestive spices.
